name: Rabies vaccine

overview.mechanism: Induces an active immune response against rabies virus.
uses: Pre- and post-exposure rabies prevention; exact vaccine, route and regimen require verification.

sources.citation: FDA Philippines product records preserved in website registry shards; exact generic heading inspected 2026-11-25. Cached identity information, not a new verification of present registration validity or product insert.

Sanofi. IMOVAX RABIES US prescribing information. DailyMed setba 8 d 4 e 72-f 452-4859-ae 6 f-3644 b 4 b 0 a 78 c; verified 2026-11-25. Human-diploid-cell IM comparator, not an exact-match label for all Philippine products.

Quiambao BP, et al. Intradermal post-exposure rabies vaccination with purified Vero cell rabies vaccine: comparison of a one-week 4-site regimen versus updated Thai Red Cross regimen in a randomized non-inferiority trial in the Philippines. Vaccine.2019;37:2268–2277. PMID 30890382.

draft_notes: Exact Philippine product insert governs dosing. No preparation, species, route or dialysis regimen transferred from a different product.

revision_log.change: New source-linked descriptive monograph, exact cached product identity separated from comparator US labeling or clinical research.
revision_log.approved_by: W. G. M. Rivero, MD (delegated source-verification workflow; executed by Codex, 2026-11-25)

usual_adult_dose.dose: No single schedule assigned across this heading. Cached Bioshoot is IM-only; Joyrab, Verorab and Chirorab records list IM/ID. Do not infer ID authorization from another brand or import the US IMOVAX volume/schedule [[PHREG,IMOVAX]]

contraindications: US IMOVAX comparator: life-threatening component hypersensitivity contraindicates pre-exposure use; its post-exposure section lists no contraindications. This does not establish the exact local product contraindication wording [[IMOVAX]]

serious: Anaphylactic reactions are a recognized IMOVAX-label concern [[IMOVAX]]

monitoring: IMOVAX reference: appropriate treatment for anaphylaxis must be immediately available. Altered immunocompetence may reduce response [[IMOVAX]]

key_interactions.action: IMOVAX label advises avoiding during post-exposure prophylaxis unless essential; specialist review must use the actual product and regimen [[IMOVAX]]

evidence.title: Product and route-specific evidence
evidence.intro: No renal dose reduction or dialysis schedule is inferred from these sources.

rows.findings: Verorab and Joyrab explicitly describe Vero-cell preparations; strain, labeled potency and dose presentation differ.
rows.limitations: Shared generic heading does not establish interchangeable route, vial volume or prophylaxis schedule.

rows.design: Open-label Philippine phaseIII trial;600 exposed participants aged≤50 years. CategoryII assignment was nonrandom; CategoryIII participants were randomized.
rows.intervention: Verorab intradermal research regimens, with/without equine rabies immunoglobulin according to group.
rows.findings: Day 14 seroconversion 100%, 99.4%, 98.8% across three groups; shortened-regimen comparisons met the trial noninferiority criterion. Safety/tolerability were similar.
rows.limitations: Antibody endpoint and specific vaccine/protocol. Does not authorize an ID route for IM-only brands or define the current Philippine PEP schedule.
